metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. AI Debt Tracker WEEK 1 — a second reel of a new project, not week 13 of the Private AI Valuation Agent. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B09 (verdict artifact), B10 (handoff) and B11 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The six source PNGs and their SVG sources are REFERENCE in pantry/, never slotted as media. The script's seven sections are split into eight body beats (0:32 splits into B02 design and B03 cut-off) and a limits beat is added; the split is logged in BUILD-LOG.md. FOUR THINGS NOT TO GET WRONG: the agent is NOT built, only the ground under it; 15 rather than 21 is a measurement by coverage, not a recount; 93.4% is on the per-bond quarters and 85% across all of them; and 99% is after six truth corrections on a 29-document set.
